epic.title: Epic #418 - post-phase-1 mechanisms + cleanup
epic.intent_and_why: Make the frame hold, then clean the decks. Fix the governor so readings fire and a trip acts on them; make the engine projection show the agent the whole gate; wire prose-only invariants into checks that refuse; put the engine behind typed verbs; relocate gate-specific instruction to the gate that needs it; then re-cut what survives.

definition_of_done: The governor writes per-agent readings on a SHIPPED configuration, readings keep arriving, and the trip mechanic acts on them.
The current projection carries each instruction exactly once and renders every populated gate block.
The named prose-only invariants refuse instead of hoping.
Each workstream retires the findings it subsumes, measured against a candidate set declared before it starts.
An agent drives a real role spine end to end through the MCP door, each agent holding its own server instance.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: No unevidenced claims, no silent scope cuts, and no check that cannot register its own failure. A claim about what happened brings its evidence.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Targeted automated tests plus the relevant broader suite for mechanism changes; live one-shot evidence for acceptance runs, kept as runnable scripts rather than wired into CI.
good_enough.appetite: Rigor scales with cost-to-undo, not uniformly. A reversible mistake a later run would surface again is not worth extensive up-front guarding.

hard_constraints: The episode store is a record of what happened and is never read back as a rule; no successor playbook.
Promoting an observation into docs/agents doctrine is a human call.
The MCP work never touches settings.json.
Never obey a spine rail naming a spine another agent drives (#457).
Run suites as FORCE_COLOR= NO_COLOR=1 python -m pytest -q tests; never the py launcher (#454).
fixed_decisions: Execution order is B extended, then A2, then F, then C, then E: a dependency order and not a schedule.
A Commander that finds an ordering link is not real says so rather than honouring it.
A measured negative is a complete, successful deliverable.
Launched identities remain stable across replanning.
